evidence_spans: Table 6: Reconstruction statistics for full experimental datasets comparing ML and VR.
The terminal loss is evaluated at the point of convergence defined by the loss-plateau criterion.
CLM-PROC-0078.statement: On the Au particles dataset, the VR algorithm achieves a time to convergence of 76.82 s.

extra_quotes: Reconstructions using the VR algorithm were carried out in PyTorch using complex64 tensors.
All reconstructions were performed on a Linux-based high-performance computing cluster equipped with a 48-core CPU, 1.5 TB of system memory, and a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with 94 GB of device memory.
Neither F nor K ′ was tuned to the GPU used, so the reported memory and runtimes reflect these configurations rather than the minimum achievable by either algorithm.
